managerAccounts.a_whoSees: The menu follows your roles. Admins: accounts, invite codes, clubs, games, matches, scoresheets, logs, saved teams and settings. Competition managers: scoresheets, saved teams and settings. Club managers: My Club and My Teams. Team managers: My Teams.
managerAccounts.a_allSet: Your account is a scorer and has nothing to manage. Sign in to the scorer app with the same e-mail and password.
managerAccounts.q_inviteCode: Where do I enter an invite code?
managerAccounts.a_inviteCode: Right after sign-up, on the invite code page, or later in the scorer app's user menu. The code gives the role it was made for at once.
managerAccounts.q_approve: How do I approve a new account? (admins)
managerAccounts.a_approve: Accounts › Pending: tap “Approve as scorer”, or “Roles” for other roles, and “Clubs” for the club they score for. Club and team managers are set on the club's page and in My Club, not under Roles.
managerAccounts.q_club: How do I set up a club? (admins)
managerAccounts.a_club: Clubs › “New club”: name, contact e-mail and the club's teams as in the official schedule. Save it, then pick its club managers from its accounts, or send a club manager link.
managerAccounts.a_savedTeams: The squads of each season and league, including the ones team managers keep in My Teams. Scorers load them in Match setup.

import.title: Import from Excel or CSV
import.intro: Fill in the template (the sheet Entries, and Matches for your own plan) and choose the file, or one CSV file per sheet. You see a preview first; nothing changes before you apply it.

template.title: OpenBeach import
template.line1: One row per pair in the sheet Entries. Draw (the category, e.g. A1) and Gender name the draw; a draw the tournament does not have yet is created.
template.line2: A pair is found by both licence numbers, else by both names. A blank cell keeps the value. A pair missing from the file is withdrawn.
template.line3: Seeds: when a draw has seeds in the file, they replace the seeds of the draw.
template.line4: The sheet Matches is optional, for your own plan: each row finds its game by the game number and sets the date, time, court and officials. A draw without a bracket yet is drawn. Team 1 and Team 2 (a seed or a pair) are only checked.
template.line5: CSV: one file per sheet, with the same column names. Nothing changes before you apply the preview.

walkthrough.waitingDialog: Finish the open dialog first: then the walkthrough goes on.
walkthrough.notOnScreen: This is not on the screen right now.
walkthrough.tapToGoOn: Tap the highlighted control to go on.

homeCard.title: New here? Take the tour
homeCard.text: Your first match, step by step, on a test match: Home, every way to get a roster in, the coin toss, the sets and the match end.

panel.title: Your first match
panel.text: A guided tour on a test match, from Home to the match end. Nothing counts and nothing is sent.

homeNew.title: New match
homeNew.text: An official game. Signed in, the button reads “SV match” and you load the game from the Swiss Volley schedule; without an account the match stays on this device.

homeTest.title: Test match
homeTest.text: Everything works, nothing counts. This walkthrough runs on a test match.

homeEasy.title: Easy match
homeEasy.text: Just the score and shirt numbers: no rosters, no signatures.

homeRestore.title: Restore match
homeRestore.text: Game number + game PIN: continue a match from another device, or bring one back.

homeOptions.title: Options
homeOptions.text: Theme, the tap hints, point entry (rallies or continuous), effects and speed, the set 2-3 break.

homeHelp.title: ? on every screen
homeHelp.text: The help of that screen: short videos, answers and “Show me”. This walkthrough starts from there too.

setupTop.title: Back / Scoresheet / Options
setupTop.text: Back to Home (the match stays there), the scoresheet preview, Options.

setupInfo.title: Match info
setupInfo.text: “Load match from schedule” fills it from the Swiss Volley schedule; “Edit” changes it by hand.

setupTeams.title: The teams
setupTeams.text: Each team: its name, shirt colour and the count of players, liberos and bench officials.

setupCoinToss.title: Coin toss
setupCoinToss.text: Lights up when everything is complete. If it is grey, the yellow “!” tells you what is missing.

setupEditRoster.title: Edit roster
setupEditRoster.text: Opens the team's roster. Tap it: the next chapter shows every way to get the roster in.

rosterType.title: Type the players
rosterType.text: Number, last name, first name, Licence/DoB, libero, C, then Add. The number can wait: the coin toss waits for it.

rosterPdf.title: Upload PDF
rosterPdf.text: The team's roster PDF or the Einsatzliste, from this device: “Local”.

rosterRemote.title: Remote
rosterRemote.text: The coach uploads the roster on roster.openvolley.app with your upload PIN, or sends it from the manager page. Tap “Remote”: a demo upload is waiting.

rosterUploaded.title: Roster uploaded
rosterUploaded.text: The uploaded roster with its players and bench officials. “Preview” shows it, “Accept” takes it, “Reject” puts it aside. Tap “Accept”.

rosterSaved.title: Load saved team
rosterSaved.text: Signed in: a team of your account, with its players and their numbers. Here a demo team, nothing comes from a server. Tap “Load saved team”.

rosterSavedPick.title: Pick the team
rosterSavedPick.text: Tap the demo team: it replaces the roster (the app asks first).

rosterClub.title: Add from club
rosterClub.text: Signed in: your club's licence lists. Tap “Add from club”.

rosterClubPick.title: Your club's players
rosterClubPick.text: Tick who plays, then add them. A player the saved team knows comes with the number; the others need one in the # field. The shield on a row shows who is on the club's lists.

rosterChoose.title: Choose players
rosterChoose.text: Tick who plays from the players the app knows for this team, then “Use n players”. Tap “Choose players”.

rosterChooseList.title: The known players
rosterChooseList.text: The list of known players: tick, untick, “All”.

rosterTest.title: Load TEST roster / Delete roster
rosterTest.text: In a test match: made-up players to try everything. Delete roster empties the list.

rosterMore.title: More ways
rosterMore.text: In Global mode the rosters come from Excel. A restored match brings its rosters, and during the match “Rosters” changes them.

rosterConfirm.title: Confirm
rosterConfirm.text: Saves the roster and goes back to Match setup. “Back” leaves the roster as it was. Tap “Confirm”.

tossRecord.title: Record the toss
tossRecord.text: Which team is A (left) and who serves first: “Switch sides” and “Switch serve”.

tossRoster.title: Show roster
tossRoster.text: Last changes: add or delete a player or a bench official.

tossSign.title: Sign A / Sign B
tossSign.text: Captain and coach sign here, or later during the warm-up.

tossConfirm.title: Confirm coin toss result
tossConfirm.text: Then the connection checks, and the scoring screen. Tap it.

set1Lineups.title: Line-ups
set1Lineups.text: Enter both line-ups with the “Line-up A” and “Line-up B” buttons and choose the game captain. If you skip them, the walkthrough enters demo line-ups.

set1Start.title: Start set / Start rally
set1Start.text: At the service whistle. The first one of a set reads “Start set” and asks for the set's start time. Tap it.

set1Point.title: The point
set1Point.text: Tap the point button of the team that won the rally.

set1Requests.title: Time-out / Substitution
set1Requests.text: Tap the box to record one.
set1Requests.textPhone: Tap the tile to record one.

set1SubDialog.title: The substitution dialog
set1SubDialog.text: Who comes in, then who goes out: only legal players; several at once, then Confirm.

set1Sanctions.title: Improper request / Delay warning
set1Sanctions.text: The team sanctions; the next ones show up here too.
set1Sanctions.textPhone: The team sanctions (improper request, delay warning) and those of a player or a bench official.

set1Player.title: A player
set1Player.text: Tap a player on court: substitution, libero, sanction, injury.
set1Player.textPhone: The court: who serves, the liberos and the captains. Libero and Sanction below act on the players.

set1Decision.title: Decision change / Undo
set1Decision.text: Give the point to the other team or replay it (the score before and after is shown), or undo.

set1Match.title: Match
set1Match.text: Rosters, history, set preview, corrections, show on a scoreboard, stop the match…

setEnd.title: Set end
setEnd.text: At 25 with two points ahead the app ends the set: confirm the end time, or “Decision change” if the last point was wrong. The rest of the set got demo rallies. Tap “Confirm”.

set2Start.title: Start of set 2
set2Start.text: The teams change sides: enter the new line-ups, then Start set. The break runs on the screen.

set5Skip.title: Skip to set 5
set5Skip.text: Sets 2 to 4 get demo rallies, as if they were played (the scoresheet prints them), until it is 2:2. Then set 5 goes on live.

set5Toss.title: Before set 5
set5Toss.text: A new coin toss for the deciding set: “Switch sides”, “Switch serve”, then confirm the set 5 setup. Tap the confirm button.

set5Switch.title: Court switch at 8
set5Switch.text: In set 5 the teams change courts at 8 points: the app asks, the line-ups stay. Tap “Switch courts”.

endComplete.title: Match complete
endComplete.text: The winner, the results and the sanctions, as on the scoresheet.

endSignatures.title: Signatures
endSignatures.text: The captains sign, then the scorers and the referees. A technical remark can be added for the administration.

endSign.title: Sign
endSign.text: On the screen, or on the person's own phone.

endScoresheet.title: Scoresheet
endScoresheet.text: Preview, print or save the scoresheet as a PDF. That's the whole match: well done.

walkthrough.dialogOpen: The walkthrough waits until the dialog is closed.

source.description: Take a photo of the printed list, or choose a picture of it on this device.
source.tipFlat: Lay the list flat and hold the device straight above it.
source.tipLight: Good light, no shadow across the names.
source.tipWhole: The whole page in the picture, sharp.
source.private: Read on this device: the photo is not sent or kept.

crop.description: Drag the four corners onto the corners of the page. The thick edge is the top: Turn moves it.

confirm.description: Check every row and correct what was misread. Nothing changes until you tap Use.
confirm.struck_one: Left out, struck out on the list: {{names}}
confirm.struck_other: Left out, struck out on the list ({{count}}): {{names}}

issue.duplicateNumber: This number is on the list twice.
issue.licence: Check the licence number: digits only, as on the list.
issue.unsure: Hard to read in the photo: check it.
issue.captainLibero: A libero cannot be the captain.

error.photo-unreadable: The photo could not be opened. Try another one.
error.ocr-load: The text recognition could not start. On the web it needs a connection the first time (about 12 MB). Try again, import the PDF or type the players.
error.ocr-timeout: Reading took too long on this device. Try a sharp photo with only the list in it, import the PDF or type the players.
error.ocr-empty: No player row was found. Check that the whole list is in the photo and sharp, then try again.
error.ocr-blurry: The photo is too blurry to read. Take it again: hold the tablet still, with good light, the whole list sharp.
